subject: Are there more documentations on using jQuery to modify the page?

messages.author: 40b63348dbcb447d
messages.subject: Are there more documentations on using jQuery to modify the page?
parts:
In my plan, Initially my page will show 2 radio buttons in the sidebar panel: "RGB" and "HSV". If the user click one of them, say, "RGB", another group of radio buttons, "Red", "Green" and "Blue" will show up under the color specification group. So far I can do this by

    radioButtons("colorSpec","Color Specification",choice=c("RGB","HSV")),
    
    conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.colorSpec == 'RGB'",
      radioButtons("fixedRGBChannel","Choose the channel with fixed color value", choice=c("Red","Green","Blue"))),
    
    conditionalPanel(
      condition = "input.colorSpec == 'HSV'",
      radioButtons("fixedHSVChannel","Choose the channel with fixed color value", choice=c("Hue","Saturation","Value"))),

But I also want a slider to appear next to the component that the user has chosen. I don't know how to do it with R code and I think it may be necessary to resort to jQuery. Does anyone have the idea on how to fulfill the task? Thanks very much.
